primary.name: Jade Green
primary.description: Matches the glossy jade-green checkmark/arrow in the logo. Replaces the old emerald.
primary.usage: Primary CTA buttons, active state highlights, success badges, main navigation active icons. E-mail links.

secondary.name: Bronze / Gold
secondary.description: Matches the 3D bronze/copper ring, gears, and businessman in the logo. Replaces the old amber/orange.
secondary.usage: Secondary buttons, accents, warning/pending badges, subtle borders, card hover borders, notification bell badges.

background.usage: The site must be 'blanc prédominant'. Use pure white (#FFFFFF) for all cards, sidebars, topbars, and panels. Use a very subtle off-white (like slate-50 or neutral-50) for the main application background wrapper so the white cards pop. DO NOT use dark panels anymore.

typography.strategy: Keep existing fonts, update weights and tracking to modern SaaS standards.

headings.style: tracking-tight, primarily text-slate-900. Use font-light for large expressive headers, font-extrabold for KPI numbers.

body.style: tracking-normal, text-slate-600 for descriptions, text-slate-900 for important values.

rules: CRITICAL: The logo has a non-transparent pure white background.
It MUST ONLY be placed inside containers that have a pure white background (bg-white).
Never place it on slate-50, gray, dark, or colored backgrounds. It will look like a white block.
Ensure it maintains aspect ratio (object-contain) and size appropriately (h-10 to h-16).

landing_page.hero: White background, large slate-900 typography with Jade Green highlight words. Bronze secondary accents.
landing_page.action_cards: Pure white cards with 1px border. On hover, the border shifts to Bronze-400 and the card slightly lifts (-translate-y-1).

login_page.layout: Centered clean white card on a soft slate-50 background, OR split screen with left side pure white (for form and logo) and right side featuring a subtle brand graphic (bronze/jade abstract).

punch_kiosk.layout: Change completely from dark slate-900. Make the background soft slate-50. The main punch module must be a prominent, elevated pure white card (shadow-xl, rounded-2xl). Logo is placed at the top of this white card. Numpad buttons should have light borders, highlighting with Jade or Bronze on press.

dashboard_sidebar.layout: Pure white (bg-white) with border-r border-slate-200. Replaces any dark emerald backgrounds.
dashboard_sidebar.active_state: bg-jade-50 text-jade-700 with a left border indicator border-l-4 border-jade-600.

dashboard_modules.cards: All 13+ modules (KPIs, scheduling, payroll) are pure white (bg-white) cards with subtle slate-200 borders and diffuse shadow-sm.
dashboard_modules.baiia_performance: Previously dark emerald-950. Convert to a pure white card. Give it a distinctive accent, like a border-t-4 border-bronze-500, to make it stand out without breaking the light theme.

pdfs_and_emails.branding: Header must be pure white to host the logo. Update all accent colors from old emerald/amber to the new Jade Green and Bronze palette.

general: DO NOT use generic centered layouts. Use clean, left-aligned, bento-grid structures typical of high-end SaaS.
Create depth through layered design elements (slate-50 app bg -> pure white cards -> shadows).
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for cards, dropdowns, or headers. Use solid white (bg-white).
Add micro-animations for hover states on all interactive elements (transitions, subtle transform, color shifts).
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for robust automated testing (e.g. data-testid='login-button').
Ensure all generated components use .js or .jsx extensions, NOT .tsx.
